question: The sixth decile (**D₆**) of 5, 3, 2, 6, 8, 4 is:
solution:
The correct answer is **5.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deciles **divide a data set into ten equal parts.
 
• The nth decile separates the lowest (10n - 90)% of the data from the highest (90 - 10n)% of the data.
 
• To calculate the decile, the data must be sorted and the formula D_n = X[{{n} over 10} times (N+1)] must be used.
 
• If the result is not a whole number, interpolation must be used to estimate the decile value.
 
• Deciles are often used in statistics to summarize a data set and to identify the values that separate the data into different percentiles.
 
• Deciles are just one type of quantile. Other quantiles, such as quartiles and percentiles, can also be calculated.
 
• The value of the decile can be affected by outliers and extreme values in the data set. It is important to identify and handle outliers before calculating deciles to ensure accurate results.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The deciles are a set of quantiles that divide a data set into ten equal parts.
 
• The 6th decile (D6) is the value that separates the lowest 60% of the data from the highest 40% of the data.
 
 
• In other words, 60% of the data values are below D6 and 40% of the data values are above D6.
 
• To calculate the 6th decile for the given data set, we first need to sort the data in ascending order: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8.
 
 
 
• The formula to calculate the decile is as follows:
 
 
• D_n = X[{{n} over 10} times (N+1)] , where X is the sorted data set, n is the decile (in this case, 6), and N is the number of data points (in this case, 6).
 
• D₆ = X[{6 over 10} times {(6+1)}] = X[4.2]
 
 
 
• Since 4.2 is not a whole number, we use interpolation to estimate the 6th decile:
 
 
• D₆ = {0.8 times X[4] + 0.2 times X[5])} = {(0.8 times 5 + 0.2 times 6) } = 5.2
